facts.fact: The Cybernetica case study (20 January 2026) says the Government of Kenya has released a 10-year Digital Master Plan spanning 2022 to 2032 as a blueprint for its digitalisation efforts, so the as-at date falls inside its period; the document describes the plan as guiding digital government and digital public infrastructure and does not link its text.
